context_requirements: Active DNA replication (S-phase entry) for replicative polymerase inhibition to cause damage
Intact p53 pathway for robust G1 arrest and apoptosis
Cellular uptake of the inhibitor (many DNA polymerase inhibitors are poorly permeable)
Proliferating cells; quiescent or non-dividing cells will show little response
falsifiers: No change in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any line
No induction of p53 targets (CDKN1A, GADD45A) at 6 or 24 h
Predominant G2/M arrest rather than G1 arrest
No evidence of DNA damage response (no upregulation of repair genes or apoptosis markers)
Strong transcriptional response in non-proliferating HA1E cells comparable to cancer lines

evidence.supports: DNA polymerase inhibition causes G0/G1 arrest in human tumor cell lines
Replicative DNA polymerase inhibitors suppress growth of human cancer cell lines
DNA polymerase inhibitor arrests cells at G1 and induces p53-dependent apoptosis
DNA polymerase inhibition increases DNA damage and induces apoptosis in human colon carcinoma cells

changes: Removed generic proliferation genes (MCM3, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, BUB1B, PLK1, KIF20A, KIF2C) from proximal_down; these are not immediate transcriptional targets of DNA polymerase inhibition.
Removed generic stress/apoptosis genes (BAX, BID, CASP3, CASP7, CASP10, DFFA, DFFB, PARP1, PARP2, XBP1) from late_up; these are downstream generic effects, not specific to DNA polymerase inhibition.
Removed GADD45B from late_up; it is a generic stress gene not specifically induced by DNA polymerase inhibition.
Removed CDKN1A, GADD45A, TP53 from late_up to avoid duplication with proximal_up; p53 targets are early proximal responses.
Removed CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, CDC20, CDC25A, CDC25B from late_down to avoid duplication with proximal_down; these are early cell-cycle genes.
Changed primary_targets from PNP to empty list; PNP is not a DNA polymerase and no evidence supports it as the primary target.
Changed kinetics from slow to moderate; DNA polymerase inhibition causes DNA damage and cell-cycle arrest within 6-24 h, not slow.
Changed magnitude at 6h from weak to moderate; p53 and DNA damage responses can be detected by 6 h.
Changed magnitude at 24h from moderate to strong; robust arrest and apoptosis are expected by 24 h.
Changed line_response for HA1E from weak to moderate; HA1E is proliferative and should respond similarly to other lines.
Changed line_response for A549 from moderate to weak; A549 has mutant KRAS and may be less sensitive to DNA polymerase inhibition.
Changed line_response for HEPG2 from moderate to weak; HEPG2 has mutant TP53 and may have impaired p53-dependent responses.
Changed line_response for MCF7 from moderate to weak; MCF7 has mutant PIK3CA and may be less sensitive.
Changed line_response for PC3 from moderate to weak; PC3 is TP53-null and may have impaired p53-dependent responses.
Changed line_response for VCAP from moderate to weak; VCAP is TP53-null and may have impaired p53-dependent responses.
Removed evidence PMID 37778414; it concerns ATR inhibition, not DNA polymerase inhibition.
Removed evidence PMID 20126977; it concerns conjugated eicosapentaenoic acid, not a direct DNA polymerase inhibitor.
Removed evidence PMID 12535613; it concerns a DNA polymerase inhibitor but the abstract does not support the claim about G1 arrest and p53-dependent apoptosis.
Removed evidence PMID 23174220; it concerns a DNA polymerase inhibitor but the abstract does not support the claim about suppression of growth of human cancer cell lines.
Removed evidence PMID 17178223; it concerns a DNA polymerase inhibitor but the abstract does not support the claim about G0/G1 arrest.
